text: Drug A is commonly used to treat hypertension. It works by relaxing blood vessels and improving blood flow.
Drug A may cause side effects such as dizziness headache and fatigue in some patients.
Drug B is prescribed for type 2 diabetes. It helps lower blood sugar levels by increasing insulin sensitivity.
Common side effects of Drug B include nausea weight gain and mild gastrointestinal discomfort.
Drug C is an antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections such as pneumonia and bronchitis.
Drug C may cause allergic reactions in some patients including rash and itching.
Drug D is used to manage chronic pain. It acts on the central nervous system to reduce pain signals.

Patients taking Drug E may experience insomnia dry mouth and changes in appetite.
Drug F is used to treat asthma. It helps open airways and improve breathing.
